critical_steps: The deleted energy is bounded by C ||f||^2.
Hence the deleted energy is bounded by C ||K^dagger||^2 ||K* f||^2.
Subtracting from the original woven lower bound yields A-C||K^dagger||^2.
The example K=I/2, two identical weave labels, one active index and one zero index satisfies the printed threshold but deletion leaves zero energy.
integrity.proof_basis: Direct reconstruction of the source proof and an exact one-dimensional counterexample with a proper deleted index subset.
integrity.unproved_limits: No necessity theorem for the corrected scalar threshold is asserted, and no downstream source statement is re-certified.

scientific_limitations: The result corrects the sufficient deletion criterion in Theorem 2.5; it is not claimed to characterize all deletions that preserve weaving.
The scalar C is a coarse operator-norm loss bound, so sharper criteria can use the actual compressed operators.
The claim does not reassess other results in the source.
title: The deletion threshold for woven \(K\)-\(g\)-fusion frames needs the pseudoinverse factor on the loss
